label: Copy phase of long sequences, early recalls (2-4) and final recalls
explanation: Fires only in the copy phase (never on original tokens or the delimiter, never at recall 0-1). Mostly in long sequences (L=9 holds 68% of mass, L=8 23%, nothing for L<=5). Within a sequence it peaks at recall positions 2-4 (recall 3 is the peak) and again at the last two outputs of L=9 sequences (t=16-17). Inside these positions only ~30-40% of steps fire, and which ones depends weakly on token identity (digit inputs, repeated tokens and digit-heavy sequences give higher rates) with no clean rule. Magnitude is small (max 0.016); the largest activations are mostly at late copy steps of L=9 sequences.
